nested_escape.trigger: Reduced motion, phone quotation-actions sheet, Ctrl+K, Escape from focused palette textbox.
nested_escape.before_result: Both palette and underlying quotation actions dismissed by a single key gesture.
nested_escape.cause: Palette keydown closes and restores underlying focus before the same Escape keyup dismisses that underlying overlay.
nested_escape.repair: Palette delegates Escape solely to shared captured keyup overlay handler, which stops the event after the top overlay handles it. Native Modal onRequestClose remains.
nested_escape.regression: e2e/redesign-command-palette.spec.ts: reduced-motion first Escape preserves underlying sheet and restores its focus; second distinct Escape closes remaining sheet and restores original trigger.
nested_escape.focused_browser_status: Passed all3 applicable phone profiles in final rebuilt focused report; first Escape preserves underlying sheet and second distinct Escape dismisses it.

proven_repairs.history: Present, past, future and coalescing metadata share one state; hook stack transitions avoid replayable updater side effects and queued undo uses the latest document.
proven_repairs.overlay: Close callback and dismissal policy update in a layout effect after commit so an abandoned render cannot change the active event listener.
proven_repairs.source_of_candidates: output/operations/sdk57-remediation-20261006; independently reproduced against supported SDK55 source
proven_repairs.quotation_actions_accessibility: BuilderTopbar Quotation actions rows now use explicit accessibilityLabel=item.label, removing icon glyphs from spoken action names. History tests retain exact accessible name assertions and select the visible rendered actions control rather than assuming the raw viewport breakpoint.

controlled_validation.test_model: Actual-source TypeScript executed with controlled hooks; updater replay, queued events and commit/abandoned-render scheduling. This is a hermetic behavior model, not a React renderer or physical device.

browser_validation.scope: Actual quotation fields and responsive toolbar/actions sheet; undo, redo, branch clearing, initial and final disabled state. Every API intercepted.

focused_initial.failures: New history test failed before mutation: phone action accessible names included spoken icon glyph; 768px test assumed viewport breakpoint rather than actual builder container control.

focused_after_labels.history_failure: Phone initial disabled check and small-phone disabled future check sent Escape before asserting the newly rendered sheet had acquired focus. No history field assertion failed.
focused_after_labels.trace_evidence: Phone trace: disabled assertion ended11456ms, Escape began11456.3ms; no focus-ready assertion existed. Timing is consistent with deferred focus setup but does not itself record the timer callback.
focused_after_labels.test_correction: Await observable exact Close button focus on each sheet opening before action/disabled checks and Escape. No sleeps or source change.

focused_final.scope: Final rebuilt source palette8 cases and quotation history1 case across8 browser profiles; two mobile-only palette cases intentionally skip5 non-phone layouts each. All business API requests intercepted.

limits: Unsigned exports and browser profiles do not certify signed native or physical-device acceptance.
BuilderContext existing line-ID mutators call Date.now/Math.random inside updater callbacks. The hook repair removes hook-owned side effects; it does not assert all caller-provided mutators are pure.
Security, legal/operator facts, original media and reviewer account remain separately gated.
